
This PR upgrades the database version to 5. You cannot use it in an app which does not know database version 5, let alone the app cannot downgrade it.
However, importing a database with a lower version number should result in a successful migration.

Nowhere. No one used this kind of documentation because the program which creates and opens those .dia files does not run on every platform (that was at least the case when I checked it the last time).

I'd say it's just enough to put an ER diagram into the assets folder, create a Wiki page for the db and maybe link to that in the `CONTRIBUTING.md` file with a note to keep that file updated when modifying the db structure.

> Btw. how I deal with the DB-structure:

Not sure if that is a question or just a statement.

When the .dia file was originally created, neither IntelliJ nor Android Studio had good database tools. That's not the case anymore.  

I usually get the .db file from the emulator (`/data/data/org.schabi.newpipe<branch_name>/databases/newpipe.db` in the emulator's file explorer). Exporting the database as suggested by you is a good trick that saves time. After opening that file in IntelliJ or any other tool which can open db files and creating the diagram, just export the structure a svg or png. Also clicking on the notification takes you to the channel rather than to the actual video.
